sources.entry: NextGIS Web - Web GIS server for geospatial data management, web map publishing, and QGIS-centered collaborative workflows. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: NextGIS Web is an open-source Web GIS server for managing geospatial data, publishing web maps and OGC services, and collaborating on QGIS-based projects.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Web GIS server with a web interface for administration and map publishing, plus a REST API covering users, layers, services, maps and permissions. It stores vector and raster geodata, and can connect to external PostGIS databases and third-party TMS, WMS and WFS services. Data can be published as raster and vector tiles, OGC WMS, WMTS, WFS, OGC API – Features and Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF. It includes a built-in map engine for interactive web maps, a vector layer editor, attachments on features, and version history for vector data. QGIS projects can be published to it and edited server-side through the NextGIS Connect plugin.
use_cases: publish QGIS projects as web maps
serve vector and raster data via OGC WMS/WFS/WMTS
manage geodata for a team with user and group permissions
collect field data with attachments on features
connect an existing PostGIS database to web maps
host a self-hosted GIS data hub
how_to_run: Run the Community Edition with Docker (see the Community Edition link in the README for instructions)
notable: Built-in version control for vector datasets with change history and rollback
Publishes QGIS projects and supports QGIS styles via NextGIS Connect plugin
Serves Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF rasters, including from S3-compatible storage
Fine-grained permissions down to individual layers or maps
caveats: Commercial support, cloud plans and some enterprise features are paid; the free tier is limited to the cloud offering
Setup details beyond the Docker Community Edition are delegated to external documentation
